title: Lesson Plan Artifact Firewall: Week N scaffolds stay out of exported plans

claims.summary: A fresh deployed v0.15.121 UX audit exported 74/100 because one lesson-plan DOCX leaked Week N assignment scaffolding, a dictionary-definition workshop line, and Grouping metadata.
proofCommands: rg -n "Quality 74|Texture 92|Week 4 assignment|Grouping: Quiet build time" docs/V0.15.122_LESSON_PLAN_ARTIFACT_FIREWALL_ROADMAP.md src/lib/releaseManifest.js

claims.summary: Lesson-plan compilation treats Week N assignment/work variants as unsafe artifact labels, including stale modality and post-finalizer text.
The deep lesson-plan workshop line now asks students to revise a visible decision instead of exporting precise-use dictionary scaffolding, and Artifact revision block is removed from variants.
DOCX lesson-plan session outlines render grouping as Class format instead of the internal Grouping label.
The release explicitly requires a fresh deployed v0.15.122 ZIP/log audit before claiming the provider output is clean.

knownRemainingTargets: Fresh deployed v0.15.122 ZIP/log audit must prove real UX provider output no longer exports Week N assignment/work scaffolds in lesson-plan DOCX files.
Fresh deployed output must prove Texture reaches 100/100 or identify the next concrete repeated shingle.
Every exported surface must agree: UI, ZIP, manifest, quality report, source report, digest logs, DOCX/PPTX files, and local regrade.
